title: The Journey of Endodontic Biomaterials: Navigating Scientific, Clinical, Patient, and Regulatory Demands
html: The development of endodontic biomaterials requires balancing scientific performance, clinical practicality, patient expectations, and regulatory requirements. This review synthesizes these perspectives to map current strengths, limitations, and translational pathways for materials used in vital pulp therapy, root repair, and root canal filling, as well as regenerative endodontics.
